head: e3e93bb609a9b00552049ba5b6bc5613716d08e5

tests.name: a chat session in a repo subfolder stores the git top level; outside git, the folder; through a link, the real path
tests.why: title quotes MUST 1's chat cases (repo subfolder, outside git, symlink realpath)

tests.name: a task try stores the task's root and a run worker the run's root, though each works in AMC's worktrees folder
tests.why: title quotes MUST 1's task try and run worker origins

tests.name: a row stored before the field existed gets its origin worked out on read, and the stored row is not rewritten
tests.why: old row with no origin resolved on read without rewriting; title echoes the clause

tests.name: each type is resolved from the origin: standalone, knowledge, another value kept raw, no AGENTS.md, no Layout line
a repo inside the product repos folder is product even when its AGENTS.md says standalone; a sibling sharing the prefix is not
tests.why: MUST 2 case: product wins over a Layout line

tests.name: an AGENTS.md over 1 MB, or not UTF-8, is unknown with the reason, never a crash
tests.why: MUST 2 case: oversized or non-UTF-8 file gives unknown, no crash

tests.name: pack only, Settings only, and both naming the same folder: listed once, from the pack, pack first
a folder that does not exist, a file, a relative path and a non-list are refused with the reason; nothing is saved
tests.why: MUST 3 cases: missing folder and file refused with a reason

tests.name: special repos added and removed in Settings show in the session panel, off; a pack-listed one is not removable; the panel names the repository's type
tests.why: only test of the Settings UI add/remove and the pack row not being removable; host-level unit tests cover the list rules

tests.name: a repo added in Settings while a session is open shows at its next read, off, and can be switched on
tests.why: MUST 4 case: add while a session is open, new switch off

tests.name: removing a switched-on repo in Settings drops it before the next message, and adding it back starts off
tests.why: MUST 4 case: remove a switched-on repo before the next message

tests.name: after a host restart the Settings list and the switches on it are kept
the session view carries the origin and type for the panel's line
tests.why: the session view the panel reads includes origin and type; checks the manager method, not every API route

tests.name: special repos added and removed in Settings show in the session panel, off; a pack-listed one is not removable; the panel names the repository's type
tests.why: checks the panel's quiet type line is shown

tests: tests/unit/origin.test.ts::a row stored before the field existed gets its origin worked out on read, and the stored row is not rewritten
tests/unit/origin.test.ts::a fork and a handoff keep the origin of the session they came from, not one worked out from its folder
findings.note: Rereview item 1: lineage lookup on old rows reads only the first 64 KiB of the log, so a long hand-off record is missed and the worktree becomes the origin; the mapped tests use short records, and a base-failing test with an oversized fixture would expose it.

tests: tests/unit/origin.test.ts::a row stored before the field existed gets its origin worked out on read, and the stored row is not rewritten
tests/unit/origin.test.ts::a fork and a handoff keep the origin of the session they came from, not one worked out from its folder
findings.note: Old forks and hand-offs without a stored origin fell back to their worktree folder; the on-read test covered only a plain chat row and the fork test only new rows, so a legacy-fork fixture would have failed at head.

tests: tests/unit/special-settings.test.ts::the session view carries the origin and type for the panel's line
findings.note: Only list and get carried origin and type; the mapped test reads the manager's view, not each route's response, so a test iterating session-returning routes (added later in server.test.ts) exposes it.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::special repos added and removed in Settings show in the session panel, off; a pack-listed one is not removable; the panel names the repository's type
findings.note: Rereview item 3: the panel's type line no longer depends on the special list, but the failed-request member of that class has no test; this is a coverage gap in a browser path, not a behaviour a base-failing unit test would reveal.

tests: tests/unit/special-settings.test.ts::a saved folder deleted later is listed with its reason and never passed
findings.note: Rereview item 5: removal with two invalid saved entries is tested in one order only (keep the file, remove the missing folder); the reverse order has no test. Coverage gap, not a known failing behaviour.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::special repos added and removed in Settings show in the session panel, off; a pack-listed one is not removable; the panel names the repository's type
findings.note: At 900 px the panel was closed, so renders and the browser check never saw the type line, and few browser cases were run; a gate-run and acceptance gap in Playwright, outside what a base-failing Vitest test catches.

notes: All Vitest files here use top-level test() with no describe. The Settings UI part of MUST 3 and the visible type line of MUST 5 are checked only by the new Playwright test; host-side rules have Vitest tests. origin.test.ts, repo-type.test.ts and special-settings.test.ts are new; repo-type.test.ts imports src/host/repo-type.ts, new on the branch, so on base it fails at import. MUST 5's API clause is only partly covered at head (no route-level test).
